scope: SAY and YELL parser-visible output and current/adjacent-room range
GOSSIP/AUCTION exact channel rendering and bare-command receipt toggles
legacy GOS/AUC command aliases required by automation clients
MegaMUD and Borin consumption/emission of the recovered terminal forms

native_findings.finding: SAY formats `%s says \"%s\"`; the sender receives `You say \"%s\"`. YELL reaches the current room plus each adjacent room. The current room receives `From %s (Yelling): \"%s\"`; adjacent rooms receive anonymous `Someone yells from above/below/the <direction> \"%s\"` text from the receiver-facing opposite direction. The sender receives `You yell \"%s\"`. The message pointer is passed directly to the formatter; ANSI/color fragments are emitted separately.

`/Username <TEXT>` is one-recipient telepath. Exact visible branches include missing target/message, sender blocking, self-target, cannot-find, success `Name telepaths: message`, sender confirmation `--- Telepath Sent to Name ---`, and generic `--- Telepath Not Sent ---` for recipient blocking/ignore/rate-limit failure. A sender with TELEPATH receipt blocked cannot send telepaths.

`>Username <TEXT>` first resolves the connected user, then enforces same-room delivery. The target receives `Name says (to you) "text"`; other room observers receive `Name says (to Target) "text"`; the sender receives `--- Message Directed to Target ---`. Failed/ambiguous user resolution returns `Cannot find user!`; a resolved target outside the room or with the native hidden byte (+0x5F6) set returns `--- Message Not Sent ---`. Native branches also prove missing target/message, speech-blocked, and self-target strings.

GOSSIP delivers `%s gossips: ` plus the raw message to world recipients whose gossip receipt flag is enabled. Bare GOSSIP toggles receipt with exact `You will now/no longer receive gossip messages.` text. Attempting to send while disabled emits the exact denial plus `Type 'gossip' to turn gossip on again.`
AUCTION mirrors the world-channel shape as `%s auctions: `, with its own receipt flag, exact bare toggle text, and exact send-while-disabled denial/hint.

native_findings.finding: The communication owners contain the exact profanity rejection text, but the supplied retained configuration has profanity checking disabled. Reforged therefore does not invent an active filter for this configuration.

native_findings.owner: WCCMMUD export table + WCCMMHLP.MSG communication corpus
native_findings.finding: The native module exports `_cmd_whisper` and `_cmd_direct_message`; it has no `_cmd_tell` export. Native help documents `/Username <TEXT>`, SAY, GOSSIP, AUCTION and FORGET, with no TELL command identity. Reforged's TELL remains explicitly a compatibility extension and receives no Classic parity credit.

megamud_runtime_corroboration: Imported MegaMUD.LOG contains 23 `Name telepaths: ...` lines, including `Shisenshi telepaths: @join`.
Imported MegaMUD.LOG contains 41 `Name says (to you) \"...\"` lines, including `{ok}` remote-control responses.
These are independent client-observed corroboration of the DLL's parser-visible forms, not replacements for the native DLL evidence.
runtime_corrections: SAY/YELL no longer use Reforged-only generic adjacent-room rendering; native current-room and directional adjacent-room YELL lines are emitted.
Slash telepaths now enforce the sender's own TELEPATH block state and return native success/not-sent/malformed/self/not-found text.

The native `>` directed-message shortcut is live: connected-user resolution is realm-scoped, failed resolution returns `Cannot find user!`, resolved out-of-room/hidden targets return `--- Message Not Sent ---`, and successful same-room delivery emits target/observer/sender forms separately.
GOSSIP/AUCTION now emit native `Name gossips:` / `Name auctions:` lines, exact bare toggles, and exact send-while-disabled branches.
GOS/AUC aliases route to GOSSIP/AUCTION for legacy automation compatibility without changing native rendered output.

Borin emits slash telepaths and full GOSSIP/AUCTION commands, preserves punctuation payload case, and parses native telepath/direct/gossip/auction lines. Legacy autonomous TELEPATH/GOS output is translated at the client boundary.
